finding: Trigger-6 objective selection can produce a false-free result when it checks only create-only claim paths: R6-SEED-005 E1_SOURCE_READ had no claim file, but legacy/source-archaeology evidence already covered the same AgentSight commit and had reached E2.

requested_repair.decision_law: A missing claim path means only mutex-unclaimed. It must not mean evidence-unworked. Legacy evidence at the same objective/source identity blocks duplicate research unless an explicit source or architecture delta justifies a named REVIEW objective.
requested_repair.acceptance_test: Fixture with no claim file but matching legacy E2 delta at same source pin must resolve OCCUPIED_BY_LEGACY_EVIDENCE; fixture with changed source pin or named architecture delta may resolve REVIEW_ELIGIBLE; truly unseen objective resolves CLAIM_ELIGIBLE.
requested_repair.negative_test: Do not infer research completion from a claim alone; a claim still carries zero evidence credit.
